head: codex/5830-cognitive-profile
title: [v0.92][WP-13] ACP / cognitive profiles
body:
Closes danielbaustin/agent-design-language#5830

Implements the deterministic WP-13 Runtime v3 cognitive-profile contract over landed birthday, identity, continuity, and capability authorities. Profiles bind seven governed evidence categories, canonical revision lineage, bounded internal/public projections, privacy policy, and explicit nonclaims.

Focused proof: exact cognitive_profile target 11/11 passed and strict Clippy passed. GitHub Actions run 31400973911 passed the exact 11-test inventory on native Linux x86_64 and macOS arm64; independent validation bound both receipt packets, source manifests, runner provenance, sanitized logs, artifact 9068009246, and identical semantic SHA dd8cb6901d88b1412ed89715ccf053f26eb95c47e69be2174b447e14ba08b736 to exact candidate head 60197504fa86566c8c4b1983d3be09f89b595e94. Final exact-head review approved with no actionable findings.

This does not claim diagnosis, reputation, standing, rights, citizenship, personhood, consciousness, downstream governance, or final birthday completion.
